en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya Al Attar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Zahir, from Al Hassan Bin Musa, from Ali Bin Hassan, from Abdul Rahman Bin Kaseer who said,

‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘We are the Master of the Command of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the treasurers of the Knowledge of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and the Repositories (Mines) of the Revelation of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya al-‘Attar has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu Zahir from al-Hassan ibn Musa from Ali ibn Hassan from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Kathir who has said that he heard Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“We are the ones who has said the following possess Divine authority of the command of Allah, we are the treasury of the knowledge of Allah and the repository of the revelations of Allah.”
